batchA.name: Batch A — Local Acceptance Candidate
batchA.description: Markets with complete engine coverage, operational domestic adapters, and immediate GM-9A testing capability.
batchA.notes: Philippines is the primary test market for GM-9A full integrated local acceptance.

keyPrerequisites: Global Payment Provider (e.g. Stripe, Adyen) Onboarding
Automated Global KYC Provider (e.g. Sumsub, Veriff) Integration
Subnational Tax Policy Formal Legal Validation (US state sales tax, etc.)

batchC.name: Batch C — Broad Global Jurisdictions
batchC.description: Established markets with verified GLCC foundations awaiting provider selection and jurisdiction-specific tax/invoice profiles.
keyPrerequisites: Provider selection across payment, payout, and KYC

batchD.name: Batch D — Specialized Regulatory & High-Barrier Markets
batchD.description: Markets with statutory telecommunications licensing, strict data localization, or cross-border restrictions.
